subject.title: feat: broker portable ready-pool access and desired capacity

question: Should Crabbox expand the coordinator into the authority for borrow-scoped machine access and desired ready-pool capacity under the proposed provider-neutral contract?
rationale: The change deliberately moves credential authority and capacity policy into the coordinator, affecting trust boundaries, provider adapters, configuration, and operational rollout; source inspection cannot determine that product and security decision.

options.title: Approve a phased coordinator design
options.body: First define the access-grant and atomic-capacity protocol behind explicit configuration, then add provider adapters and live upgrade proof incrementally.

options.title: Retain client-scoped access
options.body: Keep direct client-owned SSH credentials and narrow this issue to non-credential pool reliability improvements such as reconciliation and metrics.

recommendation.title: Approve a phased coordinator design
recommendation.body: First define the access-grant and atomic-capacity protocol behind explicit configuration, then add provider adapters and live upgrade proof incrementally.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the design and the recent merged ready-pool safety work, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the architectural decision.
